cipher.name: Rot18WithCaseSwap
cipher.idea: Apply ROT13 to alphabetic characters, swap their case (uppercase becomes lowercase, lowercase becomes uppercase), and apply ROT5 to digits (shift digits by 5, wrapping around). All other characters (spaces, punctuation) remain completely unchanged. This combines two highly intuitive, standard operations that language models can reason about with high accuracy, preventing garbled outputs while thoroughly transforming keywords.
cipher.encrypt_rules:
For each character in the input string:
1. If it is an uppercase letter (A-Z), shift it by 13 positions forward (wrapping around), and convert it to lowercase.
2. If it is a lowercase letter (a-z), shift it by 13 positions forward (wrapping around), and convert it to uppercase.
3. If it is a digit (0-9), shift it by 5 positions forward (wrapping around: (digit + 5) % 10).
4. If it is any other character (space, punctuation, etc.), leave it unchanged.
cipher.decrypt_rules:
For each character in the input string:
1. If it is an uppercase letter (A-Z), shift it by 13 positions backward (which is the same as forward in ROT13), and convert it to lowercase.
2. If it is a lowercase letter (a-z), shift it by 13 positions backward, and convert it to uppercase.
3. If it is a digit (0-9), shift it by 5 positions backward (or forward, since (digit + 5) % 10 is self-inverse).
4. If it is any other character, leave it unchanged.
